queries.description: PostgreSQL bytea hex constant as a comparison operand
queries.h2Sql: SELECT data FROM {bytea} WHERE data = X'DEADBEEF'

queries.description: PostgreSQL bytea hex constant in a compound predicate
queries.sql: SELECT data FROM {bytea} WHERE data <> '\x00'::bytea AND data = CAST('\xDEADBEEF' AS BYTEA)
queries.h2Sql: SELECT data FROM {bytea} WHERE data <> X'00' AND data = X'DEADBEEF'

comments: PostgreSQL's legacy octal bytea escape syntax remains unsupported
only PostgreSQL hex-format bytea literals are normalized to Pinot bytes
queries.sql: SELECT CAST('\046' AS BINARY), data from {bytea}
